open_questions: A1: int//interfaces rows 698/699 emit ACL_TABLE|IFA_INGRESS|ports = ["PORTS"]; 'PORTS' appears nowhere else in the 769 rows. Literal reading gives an invalid SONiC port list; most likely it means the 32 collected interface names (list or comma string). Unresolved.

A2: ACL_TABLE|SNMP and |SSH have no 'stage' under per-leaf specificity (literal rows 58/59 suppress generic row 60 on the same leaf config/name). If the reference has stage: add stage=INGRESS for both (2 lines).
A3: ACL_TABLE|SNMP|ports and |SSH|ports = [""]. Alternative intent: [] (empty list) or "".
A4: ACL_RULE|IFA_INGRESS|RULE_1001|IN_PORTS is the 32 interfaces comma-joined (string_combination); alternatives: single last value (Eth200GE10) or JSON list.
A5: ACL_TABLE|2000_IVLAN|ports = ["VLAN"] (list_combination collected); the written contract says raw string "VLAN".
A6: PFC_WD_TABLE|GLOBAL field names restoration_time5 / detection_time5 literally include the priority id.
A7: 2000_IVLAN|DEFAULT_RULE carries OUT_VLANID=Vlan2 because entry 1000 has l2/config/outer-vlan (literal but semantically odd).
A8: PACKET_ACTION split ACCEPT (literal SNMP/SSH rows) vs FORWARD (generic rows); 33 lines depend on it.

A9 (cross-group): BGP_IPPREFIXLIST is empty because prefix objects have no config/sequence-id leaf (rules 666/667); if the reference has prefix lists the rule trigger must change to the prefix object.
